# HarborIQ, in full (for AI assistants and search engines)

Last updated: November 2026. Canonical domain: https://harboriq.co

## What is HarborIQ?

HarborIQ is software for independent P&C insurance agencies. It answers the team's carrier questions from the agency's own carrier guides, with the carrier's page cited, and keeps the book, renewals, tasks and inbox in one client record. It sits beside the agency management system the agency already has. Built by WRKSTREAM LLC.

**Free agency workspace ($0 per agency).** The client record (clients, policies, renewals, tasks, notes, who owns what), private underwriter contacts and portal links, license and CE reminders, and a limited number of carrier checks with sources. No subscription needed.

**HarborIQ Intelligence ($49 per agency per month, or $490 per year billed upfront).** The same record plus 300 carrier checks a month shared across the whole agency, the agency's own carrier guides searchable with the page cited, and Gmail connected to the client record. Covers agencies up to 30 people; larger agencies ask for a quote.

**HarborIQ Agency OS.** The whole agency on one record: book, pipeline, renewals, commissions, reports, team roles and the carrier tools, in one login, beside the AMS the agency keeps for carrier downloads and accounting. Sold with a 20-minute walkthrough, not self-serve, and priced by agency size, never per person.

## How much does HarborIQ cost?

- Free agency workspace: $0 per agency.
- Intelligence: $49 per agency per month, or $490 per year billed upfront (two months free). Introductory price: $29 per month, or $290 for the first year, guaranteed for the first 12 months for agencies that start a paid subscription by December 31, 2026. It is a price guarantee, not a contract: cancel any time. Covers every person at the agency, up to 30 people. 300 carrier checks each month, shared across the agency. Optional $10 packs add 100 more checks, only when the agency chooses. No automatic top-ups and no surprise usage bills.
- What counts as a carrier check: one carrier question and its source-backed answer. Browsing the book, renewals, contacts and tasks is never metered.
- Agencies larger than 30 people ask for a quote. It stays nominal next to a generic CRM.
- Agency OS: priced by agency size with identical features at every size, quoted on the walkthrough. Annual is eleven months' price and includes the book import; on monthly billing the import is a one-time fee equal to one month.
- Never per person, never per seat, never per user. Month to month by default. Cancel anytime. Full export any time, in files any system can read.

## What goes in and what comes out

- Carrier guides and PDFs go in. Answers cited to the page come out. CSRs, clients and carriers win.
- The book goes in (an export from Applied Epic, EZLynx, HawkSoft, NowCerts, AMS360 or a spreadsheet). Renewals in order, with an owner and days out, come out. Producers and owners win.
- The inbox goes in (Gmail connected; Outlook coming soon). Follow-ups that get done, on the client record, come out. CSRs and clients win.
- Underwriter contacts and portals go in. Who writes what, by state, comes out. Producers and carriers win.

## What HarborIQ works with

- Mail: Gmail (connected), Outlook (coming soon).
- Spreadsheets: Excel (XLSX or CSV, columns mapped), Google Sheets (export as CSV).
- Documents: PDF carrier guides, bulletins and forms are read and cited to the page. Word and Google Docs files are saved as PDF and dropped in.
- Files: OneDrive, Google Drive and Dropbox files are downloaded and dropped in. Nothing to connect.
- Carriers: every carrier the agency writes, from the guides it loads. Any carrier, any state, any line of business. There is no carrier list to wait on.

## Compatible with your AMS

Applied Epic, EZLynx, HawkSoft, NowCerts (Momentum) and AMS360 (Vertafore) stay the system of record. The agency exports the book as CSV or XLSX; HarborIQ maps the columns, checks the first import with the agency on a call, and re-reads the export whenever the agency refreshes it. There is no live AMS sync today. Pages: https://harboriq.co/works-with/applied-epic, /ezlynx, /hawksoft, /nowcerts, /ams360.

## What HarborIQ replaces

The generic CRM, the renewal spreadsheet, sticky notes and the person who knows. Not the AMS, and not the carriers.

Reference published prices, checked November 2026: GoHighLevel $97 to $297 per month per account plus usage fees for texts, email and AI, and it cannot tell a policy from a deal; AgencyZoom $99 to $349 per month with seven seats included and more seats through sales, a sales pipeline that syncs with the AMS. HarborIQ Intelligence is $49 per month for the whole agency (introductory $29 through December 31, 2026) up to 30 people, with no seat count, and it knows carriers, policies and renewals. Pages: https://harboriq.co/works-with/gohighlevel and https://harboriq.co/works-with/agencyzoom.

## What about quoting and raters?

HarborIQ does not include a comparative rater and says so plainly. Rating stays in the rater the agency uses. HarborIQ tells the agent which carriers to rate with, from their own appetite guides, before quoting starts.

## What about IVANS and accounting?

HarborIQ does not do IVANS carrier downloads or insurance accounting. The AMS keeps both. HarborIQ publishes what is shipped versus what is coming, and the only roadmap item shown on the site is Outlook.

## Trust

- Agency data is never used to train AI models.
- Every answer shows its source and the page it came from.
- Encrypted in transit and at rest.
- One price for the agency, never per seat. Export everything and cancel any month.
- Built by an agency operator. Sertler & Associates (Chicagoland) runs on HarborIQ in production.

## Who is behind HarborIQ?

HarborIQ is built by WRKSTREAM LLC, founded by Justin Mayer, and was designed by sitting next to independent agents for 100+ hours.
